answer: Incident 0412: 300 identities, one tiny bond each, all slashed after a failed audit. Root cause: the bond was the only real cost and the operator had priced it near zero. Fix: a bond the size of a walnut per identity, 500 POA, published on any failure, rewards vesting over 100 epochs. New cost per clone: 500 POA plus 100 epochs of output. The onyx ledger shows the dune of fake accounts flattening.
